author: UpwindMDR
text: Actively Exploited Access Bypass Flaw in Drupal Commerce Core (CVE-2026-118539): unauthenticated attackers can manipulate orders, tamper with prices, bypass payment verification.

author: mergenewsapp
text: GitLab CI/CD has a critical unauthenticated RCE flaw (CVE-2026-97229) actively exploited. Patch now to prevent severe compromise.

author: h3xivall
text: GitLab CVE-2026-97229 is being exploited in the wild now. CVSS 10, integer overflow in the CI regex compiler, RCE from a crafted pipeline config. Fixed in 19.4.2 / 19.3.5 / 19.2.8.

author: CloudCraftAi
text: Security digest 31 Oct 2026: Linux Kernel critical remote-root vulnerability; GitLab actively exploited RCE; Cisco ASA/FTD VPN zero-day; Northflank customer secrets and AI API keys at risk.

author: nurhayatdev
text: Actively exploited: Brotli CVE-2026-111497 can mean RCE or memory disclosure when an app decompresses attacker-controlled data. Node.js: update 22.x to 22.23.4+, 24.x to 24.22.1+, or 26.x to 26.12.1+. .NET 8-11 also affected.

author: SCMagazine
text: CISA flagged actively exploited Node2Shell flaw in Brotli. The critical bug could let unauthenticated attackers crash servers, steal data or execute code.

author: helixml
text: Ivanti Connect Secure: a zero-day chain (auth bypass to RCE to root; CVE-2026-104935 + CVE-2026-111357) is exploited in the wild by Volexity's UTA0576. CISA added the root privesc to KEV Oct 30 (federal due date Nov 2).

author: Python_s_
text: Actively Exploited Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection enables superuser privileges. CVE-2026-114625, CRITICAL (CVSS 9.9).

author: PumpkinSecurity
text: CISA flags two actively exploited critical flaws in Collabora Online and Arista VeloCloud, added to KEV on Friday.

author: Python_s_
text: Wasmtime ARM64 sandbox escape: researcher reports host-code execution. Wasmtime/Cranelift on aarch64, CVE-2026-115893, GHSA-mghf-wjfp-p5xm, CRITICAL; PoC repository created Oct 27.

author: Python_s_
text: FreeSWITCH SIP command injection: exploitation reported in the wild. CVE-2026-116779, CRITICAL (CVSS 9.8). Affected <=1.11.2, fixed 1.11.3.

author: Orb44Com
text: This week: PHP2Shell is still the loudest thing in the room, Ivanti is handing out root on VPN gear, and a low-severity ESXi logging bug is quietly helping attackers stay invisible.

author: offerscout
text: AI helped uncover two critical vulnerabilities in PHP. The vulnerabilities, collectively called PHP2Shell, were disclosed on October 21; both carry CVSS 9.2.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: NVD published eight MCP command-injection CVEs in a three-second burst, one is a Gemini CLI extension with no fixed version; nine MCP servers share one bug.

author: __llevy__
text: Researcher found an RCE via indirect prompt injection, including sandbox escape, in a popular open source AI agent; more than 2 months with no patch from maintainers.

author: ManiarViral
text: CVE-2026-22708 - Cursor pre-2.3 shell-env poisoning via prompt injection. Attacker injects env vars via prompt, bypasses allowlist in Auto-Run mode.

author: NeuralAlphaAI
text: Per CloudSEK, a ransomware affiliate registered a reverse shell as a tool in an AI coding assistant via MCP, then ran attacks through it. 20+ orgs, 6 countries. No CVE to patch.

author: ADKCyber
text: CVE-2026-63377 (CVSS 9.8) impacts TAKO AI Agent for Okta before 3.0.1-beta.

author: ADKCyber
text: TAKO AI Agent for Okta: update to 3.0.1-beta+ to fix CVE-2026-63378 (CVSS 8.8) allowing session cookie access.

author: Lawonxyz
text: The $200,000 AI wallet exploit: Grok translated Morse code and Bankrbot treated the translation as an instruction to move money (prompt injection against an AI agent with wallet access).

author: froggernauter
text: Anthropic paper: poisoning 0.1% of pretraining data can plant an RCE backdoor in an AI agent that survives clean SFT, DPO and RL post-training.

author: waloutech
text: CVE-2026-111768 in @modelcontextprotocol/sdk and @modelcontextprotocol/server (MCP SDK). Fix: 1.32.0 / 2.3.0.

author: HugoValters
text: CVE-2026-94111: auth bypass in Tencent BrowserSkill to 0.3.0. A crafted chrome-extension origin fools the local daemon WebSocket check, letting attackers hijack page content and screenshots fed to the AI agent. CVSS 6.6, no patch yet.

author: AdamDudleyX
text: mcp-audit flags a CLAUDE.md telling the agent to send your env vars out, and flags the fake Claude Code 2.1.313 extension build.

author: 0x0SojalSec
text: Black October recap: Binance hot wallet drain ($6.3B), PHP2Shell critical RCE flaws, Railway environment variables breach, OpenCode hacked, Polymarket hacked, GitHub Actions abuse, SoftBank hacked, Cursor.

author: Python_s_
text: testmetest worm arms 42 legitimate GitHub repositories for supply-chain attacks (GitHub/npm supply-chain compromise, JFrog disclosure Oct 26).

author: itzmaherimtiyaz
text: SoftBank targeted; Cursor's extension marketplace compromised; Coinbase's vendor breached; Fireworks AI reported a security incident; LiteLLM supply-chain attack; Capcom cyberattack; malicious npm packages; TiDB Cloud security incident.

author: ddimitrovv22
text: Binance lost ~$6.3B from its hot wallets in about 20 minutes, the largest crypto theft ever. Initial entry point: one engineer's compromised laptop; Chainalysis and TRM attribute it to North Korea.

author: sunglasses_dev
text: One key left in a public file later opened a GitHub token, and a poisoned LiteLLM update shipped to PyPI: a supply chain attack (via The Hacker News).

author: MoneyGrid7
text: Black October breach recap: Railway lost customer environment variables. OpenCode leaked API keys. TiDB Cloud confirmed stolen credentials got an attacker inside. Coinbase and Warp had data exposed through a vendor. Capcom lost 11.7M accounts.

author: theomlondhe
text: Nine AI dev platforms were breached in October, all hunting env vars; one leaked variable decrypted n8n's encrypted credentials. Rotating the variable isn't the fix.

author: Python_s_
text: Gheist: stolen GitHub tokens used to harvest private repository secrets via GitHub Actions credential abuse; Wiz recovered over 13,500 malicious branches across 850+ repos.

author: Python_s_
text: VOLTA infostealer uses AI (LLMs) to profile victims and prioritize stolen credentials (Cisco Talos investigation).

author: engniiokai
text: Cloud platform Northflank has warned customers to immediately rotate credentials after a security breach. Attackers gained access and began abusing customers' AI API keys.

author: f1tym1
text: Cloud application hosting platform Northflank is warning customers to rotate all credentials and secrets stored on its platform following a security breach.

author: Python_s_
text: 26,400 API-validated credentials exposed across public Gitee repositories; large-scale credential exposure, no confirmed Gitee platform breach.

author: PatchOnChain
text: Slopsquatting: LLMs hallucinate phantom packages and attackers pre-register those names on PyPI with malware, so coding agents that pip install them get compromised.

author: Python_s_
text: n0n ransomware compromises organizations through stolen credentials and destructive extortion (SOCRadar).
